decision: Drop of 5 grid positions for the next Race in which the driver participates.
fact: Car 11 made contact with Car 51 in turn 14
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
penalty: Drop of 5 grid positions for the next Race in which the driver participates.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 11 (Sergio Perez), the driver of Car 51 (Rafael Camara), team representatives and reviewed video, in-car video evidence. Car 11 (PER) attempted to overtake Car 51 (CAM) on the inside, on the left-hand side, approaching Turn 14. The Stewards noted that at no point during the manoeuvre was the front axle of Car 11 at least alongside the mirror of Car 51. The two cars collided at the entry to Turn 14, resulting in Car 11 retiring from the Race. Applying the Driving Standards Guidelines, the Stewards determined that Car 11 had not earned the right to the corner and was wholly to blame for the collision. The Stewards therefore imposed a 10-second time penalty. As Car 11 retired from the Race and could not serve the penalty, it was converted into a 5-place grid penalty at the driver's next Race.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 11 Causing A Collision With Car 51
